name: Nasju
headline: I build apps, games, and the things in between.
about: I’m Amanence Junas B., Nasju for short, an Information Technology student at Cebu Eastern College in Cebu City.

I like building across the whole range: Kita, an AI-powered financial platform; White Market, a blockchain marketplace with escrow; PropConnect, which reached the grand finals of the Sinulog PropTech Hackathon; and Zoki, a booking app for a real client where I lead the development team. I’ve also been designing UI in Figma since 2023.

Games are my other half. I’ve gone from a horror driving game for a school project to game jams and Roblox titles, and after completing the Basket Accelerator 2026 internship program I was taken on as a studio lead, developing Roblox games in a Basket cohort. On campus I help run the AWS student community and coached our school team in competition.
